mechanism_narrative: The two-week decline in WORKPLACES from -6.1 to -9.4 indicates weakening commuting routines, which reduces weekday footfall available to retail and recreation venues and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains below -8.0 for the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT above +3.0 for two consecutive weeks signals transit normalization that brings shoppers back to commercial districts, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean is >= 3.0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT remaining >= 3.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When outdoor mobility PARKS stabilizes above -19 and essential shopping GROCERY_PHARM remains above 4.0, households combine errands with leisure, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -19 while GROCERY_PHARM stays above 4.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days while PARKS is above -19 and GROCERY_PHARM is above 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, RESIDENTIAL at or above 5.0 together with WORKPLACES at or below -8.0 signals stay-at-home behavior that suppresses discretionary retail, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days despite RESIDENTIAL >= 5.0 and WORKPLACES <= -8.0.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week rise in GROCERY_PHARM of at least 2.0 percentage points signals precautionary shopping and reduced discretionary trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the prior 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 2.0 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The t-0w RETAIL_REC drop to -24.6 after a three-week rise is an early seasonal cooling in discretionary activity that persists and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS rising above -19 for two consecutive weeks signals outdoor recreation recovery that spills into nearby retail and recreation venues, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean exceeds -19.0 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite PARKS exceeding -19.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, TRANSIT at or above 3.5 and PARKS at or above -20.0 jointly indicate broad mobility recovery that lifts retail and recreation visits, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT >= 3.5 and PARKS >= -20.0.
